• Inter Kashi FC vs FC Goa || Match Content || Highlights || Match 23 || 01-Nov-2026 || English ||
The Gaurs are off the mark! Watch the big moments as FC Goa beat Inter Kashi FC 2-1 in Pune to pick up their first win of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Francisco Feuillassier put Goa ahead before the break. Sumeet Passi equalised for Inter Kashi six minutes into the second half, but Chiki won it for the visitors in the 66th minute. Goa dominated with 72% of the ball and 21 shots.
